overview: ICP MCP Connector Assistant — set up the official IC MCP connector (with your custom connector name), store on-chain memory, and draft MCP-ready workflows to copy into Grok or Claude under your Internet Identity.
features: Log in with Internet Identity and see your principal
Custom MCP connector display name (e.g. Agent Identity) used in Copy for MCP instructions
Optional pre-grant of full read/write/execute agent permissions in Copy for MCP (browser-local default + per plan/workflow toggle)
Guided Setup for trusting the IC MCP server with Grok, Claude, and ChatGPT paths
Thorough how-to for creating workflows and running them in an external AI agent
Describe cross-dApp goals in chat and get numbered plans with real MCP tool hints
Offline template planner when the operator AI key is not set — still MCP-tool-aware
Copy for MCP (named connector + URL + permission rules) and save reusable workflows on-chain
Memory apps with multiple canister IDs and agent account IDs per app (included in plan prompts)
Risk warning about II-backed agents and wrong-account transfer loss
Store preferred dApps, personal rules, and notes on-chain
Dashboard with MCP status, recent plans, and first-time onboarding
History log of generated plans with re-open support
Cycle-conscious caps on history, workflows, memory size, and model context
